new.md:
Creates a new string filter.

You will want to set up the filter by providing a string to search for
and by providing a property to look up on the item.

doc.brief: Determines whether to include items by comparing strings to a fixed search term.
doc.md:
Determines whether to include items by comparing strings to a fixed search term.

The strings are obtained from the items by evaluating an expression
set with [`StringFilter.set_expression()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.StringFilter#method:set_expression), and they are
compared against a search term set with [`StringFilter.set_search()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.StringFilter#method:set_search).

`GtkStringFilter` has several different modes of comparison - it
can match the whole string, just a prefix, or any substring. Use
[`StringFilter.set_match_mode()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.StringFilter#method:set_match_mode) choose a mode.

It is also possible to make case-insensitive comparisons, with
[`StringFilter.set_ignore_case()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.StringFilter#method:set_ignore_case).
